subject: Control submission sprint: ticketing, evidence routing, procurement gating
messages:
From: Grace Liu <grace.liu@metrica.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@metrica.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RFI: SOC 2 control mapping + evidence intake process

Ben —

Thanks for the call today. As we discussed, procurement needs a clear intake path for SOC 2 and ISO 27001 artifacts so our legal and audit teams can validate the submission before contract signature. High level asks:

- A control matrix mapping (SIG/RFI -> Redwood control IDs) with a single-file index.
- Proof files (pdfs, screenshots, logs) tied to each control row.
- Ticketing or tracking mechanism so we can see owner, ETA, and evidence status.
- Procurement gating checklist (who approves, timeline expectations).

Can you confirm the expected delivery cadence and whether Redwood can accept evidence via a secure Drive link + Jira tickets? Also attach any templates so our team can review before we kick off.

We aim to have the intake complete within 10 business days post-SOW signature, but procurement needs the submission process defined ahead of that.

Appreciate it — Grace

[Attachment: Metrica_RFI_ControlMatrix.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Grace Liu <grace.liu@metrica.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 10:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFI: SOC 2 control mapping + evidence intake process

Grace —

Thanks for the clear summary. We can absolutely support the process you described. Proposed plan (short):

1) Templates: I attached our evidence index (redwood_soc2_evidence_index.pdf) and a sprint ticket template (runbook-sprint-ticket-template.csv). These are canonical for this intake.

2) Intake channel: Preferred route is a shared Drive folder (secure link) + Jira project (INF-EVIDENCE) where each control maps to a Jira ticket. That gives you owner, ETA, status, and audit trail. We will provide a crosswalk CSV that maps your Metrica_RFI_ControlMatrix rows to Redwood control IDs.

3) Roles & SLAs:
   - Redwood intake lead: Monica Patel (monica_patel@redwood.ai). Owner updates Jira and populates the Drive.
   - Evidence owners: engineering or product SMEs assigned per control. Typical SLA: initial artifact or statement within 3 business days of ticket creation; for exported logs we target 5 business days.

4) Delivery cadence: We propose a 10-business-day sprint window for an initial tranche, with daily standups for the first 3 days and then asynchronous updates.

Next steps: Monica will create the Jira project and share Drive access. If that works, please confirm and we’ll spin up the initial wave of tickets matching the matrix you attached.

Ben
Head of Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_soc2_evidence_index.pdf (pdf)]

From: monica_patel@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Metrica intake - ticketing & owners

Ben / Aditya —

I'll take lead for intake and Jira setup. Plan I'm going to follow:

- Create Jira project INF-3124 and a ticket template that includes fields: ControlID, MetricaRow, EvidenceType, FileLink, SMEOwner, ETA, EvidenceStatus.
- Pull the Metrica_RFI_ControlMatrix.xlsx into a staging Drive folder and add a metadata CSV that maps their rows to our control IDs.
- Triage controls into three buckets: (A) documentation (policy/process), (B) configuration/ops screenshots, (C) telemetry/log exports.
- For bucket C, I'll need Aditya to provide sanitized sample logs and an extraction command or export. ETA: I will have Jira + Drive permissions shared with Metrica by EOD 15 Jun.

Aditya — can you confirm you can carve a set of sample telemetry exports (redacted) for their controls relating to KV cache, routing logs, and audit trails? If yes, set ETA for those tickets to Jun 18.

Thanks — Monica
Security Intake Lead
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: runbook-sprint-ticket-template.csv (csv)]

From: Grace Liu <grace.liu@metrica.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Control submission sprint: ticketing, evidence routing, procurement gating

Monica / Ben —

This looks good and aligns with what procurement needs. We will:

- Review your evidence index and confirm the first 25 priority controls by EOD Friday.
- Accept Drive + Jira as the intake channels. Please add procurement@metrica.com as read-only on the Drive and watcher on Jira tickets.
- For any telemetry/log exports we will need a short attestation that exported logs were sampled/redacted consistent with our privacy policy.

I will circulate the priority control list shortly. Appreciate the rapid turnaround.

Best,
Grace
Senior Sourcing Manager
Metrica Financial
